title: Organic Cotton T‑Shirt
shortDescription: Soft, breathable tee made from 100% organic cotton.
detailedDescription: A classic crew‑neck t‑shirt crafted from sustainably grown organic cotton. It’s gentle on the skin, lightweight, and perfect for everyday wear. Available in multiple colors.

title: Stainless Steel Water Bottle
shortDescription: Insulated 750 ml bottle keeps drinks cold for 24 h.
detailedDescription: Double‑wall vacuum insulated stainless steel water bottle with a leak‑proof screw cap. Ideal for hiking, gym, or office use. BPA‑free and rust‑resistant.

title: Wireless Bluetooth Earbuds
shortDescription: True‑wireless earbuds with 5 h battery life per charge.
detailedDescription: Compact true‑wireless earbuds featuring Bluetooth 5.2, touch controls, and a portable charging case providing up to 20 h total playback. IPX4 sweat‑resistant.

title: Ceramic Coffee Mug Set
detailedDescription: A collection of four hand‑glazed matte ceramic mugs, each holding 12 oz. Microwave and dishwasher safe, with a comfortable ergonomic handle.

title: Yoga Mat – Extra Thick
shortDescription: 6 mm thick, non‑slip yoga mat for all levels.
detailedDescription: Eco‑friendly PVC‑free yoga mat offering 6 mm cushioning and a textured non‑slip surface. Comes with a carrying strap for easy transport.

title: Portable Power Bank 20000 mAh
shortDescription: High‑capacity external battery with fast charge.
detailedDescription: 20 000 mAh slim power bank featuring dual USB‑C output, 18 W fast charging, and built‑in safety protections. Compatible with smartphones, tablets, and laptops.

title: Bluetooth Mini Speaker
shortDescription: Compact speaker with rich sound and 8 h playback.
detailedDescription: A portable Bluetooth speaker delivering 360° sound, built‑in microphone for calls, and a rechargeable battery lasting up to 8 hours. Water‑resistant (IPX5).

title: Leather Journal
detailedDescription: Premium full‑grain leather journal featuring 200 lined pages, a durable binding, and an elastic band to keep it closed. Perfect for writing, sketching, or journaling.

title: LED Desk Lamp with USB Charger
shortDescription: Adjustable brightness lamp with built‑in USB port.
detailedDescription: Energy‑saving LED desk lamp offering three brightness levels and a flexible arm. Includes a USB‑C charging port for smartphones and tablets.

title: Stainless Steel Chef Knife
detailedDescription: High‑carbon stainless steel chef’s knife with a comfortable ergonomic handle. Ideal for slicing, dicing, and chopping a variety of ingredients.

title: Kids’ Educational Building Blocks
detailedDescription: Colorful, sustainably sourced wooden blocks encouraging creativity and motor skill development. Includes various shapes and a storage box.

title: Smart Wi‑Fi Plug
shortDescription: Control appliances remotely via app or voice.
detailedDescription: Compact Wi‑Fi enabled plug compatible with Alexa and Google Assistant. Allows scheduling, energy monitoring, and remote on/off control through a mobile app.
